hookups.source: The city's only camping statement is 'Grass Park ... 4 Electric hookups for Campers' (https://cityoflacrosseks.com/recreation, read 2026-11-06), with no amperage and no water hookups; the derived water=true rested on our note, which came from the Good Sam listing

season.source: No city page gives a camping season (City Park's restrooms are 'Seasonal'); the derived year-round rested on our note from the Good Sam listing. Read 2026-11-06

note: Small City of La Crosse camping area: four electric hookups for campers in Grass Park, the six-block park along US-183 between 1st and 2nd streets that holds the Barbed Wire Museum, with a restroom/shelter and a footbridge across the creek. The city posts no rate or rules; call City Hall. --Claude
summary: City recreation page (2026-11-06): camping is 'Grass Park ... 4 Electric hookups for Campers'; 'City Park' (US-183 east side, 2nd-4th St) lists no camping. Water and year-round cleared (Good Sam only). Website Good Sam -> city recreation page. Pin is north of both parks: move to Grass Park ~38.5256,-99.3112. Name lead: 'Grass Park'. Phone 785-222-2511 = City Hall, confirmed. No rate anywhere.
flags: IDENTITY / NAME lead (apply.py doesn't write name): the city's own page puts the camper hookups in GRASS PARK ('4 Electric hookups for Campers'), not in 'City Park', whose listing has only a playcenter, two limestone shelters and seasonal restrooms. The 'La Crosse City Park' name and 316 Peace St address come from Good Sam / aggregators (Google's 'Lacrosse City Park' at 38.52691,-99.30903 is the City Park block east of US-183). Suggest renaming to 'Grass Park (La Crosse)' or 'La Crosse Grass Park'.
